# Percent-encoding

Percent-encoding bytes for URLs, with the set of characters left as they are.

<h2 id="percent-set"><code>PercentSet</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum PercentSet {
    Component,
    Path,
    Form
}
```

Which characters percent-encoding leaves as they are.
Copy, carrying no payload. Every set leaves the unreserved characters of RFC 3986 alone, apart from `Form`, which
escapes `~` as HTML requires.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Percent.rux#L18)

**Cases**

| Name        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Component` | Only the unreserved characters: letters, digits, `-`, `.`, `_` and `~`. Right for a single query name or value, a single path segment, or any value placed between delimiters, since every delimiter is escaped. |
| `Path`      | The unreserved characters, the sub-delimiters `!$&'()*+,;=`, and `:`, `@` and `/`. Right for a whole path that is already split into segments the way it should be.                                              |
| `Form`      | The `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` serialization: letters, digits, `*`, `-`, `.` and `_` stay, a space becomes `+`, and everything else is escaped. Decoding in this set reads `+` as a space.              |

<h2 id="percent-encoded-length"><code>PercentEncodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func PercentEncodedLength(
    bytes: byte[..],
    set: PercentSet
) -> uint

pub func PercentEncodedLength(
    text: char8[..],
    set: PercentSet
) -> uint
```

How many characters the percent-encoded form of `bytes` occupies in `set`.
Exact rather than a bound: one character for each byte the set leaves alone, or for a space in the form set,
and three for every other byte. Runs in time linear in the length and allocates nothing.

| Overload                                                                  | Summary                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func PercentEncodedLength(bytes: byte[..], set: PercentSet) -> uint` | How many characters the percent-encoded form of `bytes` occupies in `set`.             |
| `pub func PercentEncodedLength(text: char8[..], set: PercentSet) -> uint` | How many characters the percent-encoded form of the bytes of `text` occupies in `set`. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Percent.rux#L54)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type         | Description                       |
| ------- | ------------ | --------------------------------- |
| `bytes` | `byte[..]`   | the bytes to encode               |
| `set`   | `PercentSet` | which characters stay as they are |
| `text`  | `char8[..]`  | the text whose bytes to encode    |

**Returns**: the number of characters [`PercentEncode`](/docs/api/encoding/percent#percent-encode) writes

<h2 id="percent-encode"><code>PercentEncode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func PercentEncode(
    bytes: byte[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    set: PercentSet
) -> uint ! FormatError

pub func PercentEncode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    set: PercentSet
) -> uint ! FormatError
```

Writes the bytes of `text` percent-encoded for `set` into `into`.
The byte form, reached without the caller reinterpreting the text first: each UTF-8 code unit is one byte, so a
character outside ASCII becomes one escape per byte of its UTF-8 form, as URIs require.
The failure the byte form reports, with the same guarantee.

| Overload                                                                                              | Summary                                                           |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func PercentEncode(bytes: byte[..], into: var char8[..], set: PercentSet) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes `bytes` percent-encoded for `set` into `into`.             |
| `pub func PercentEncode(text: char8[..], into: var char8[..], set: PercentSet) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes the bytes of `text` percent-encoded for `set` into `into`. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Percent.rux#L89)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                             |
| ------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bytes` | `byte[..]`      | the bytes to encode                                                     |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least `PercentEncodedLength(bytes, set)` characters |
| `set`   | `PercentSet`    | which characters stay as they are                                       |
| `text`  | `char8[..]`     | the text whose bytes to encode                                          |

**Returns**: the number of characters written

<h2 id="percent-decoded-length"><code>PercentDecodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func PercentDecodedLength(text: char8[..]) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

How many bytes percent-encoded text decodes to, after checking that every escape is well formed.
Each `%` followed by two hexadecimal digits of either case counts as one byte, and every other character as one.
Reports `InvalidEscape` at the first `%` that is not followed by two hexadecimal digits. Runs in time linear in
the length and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Percent.rux#L137)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type        | Description              |
| ------ | ----------- | ------------------------ |
| `text` | `char8[..]` | the percent-encoded text |

**Returns**: the number of bytes [`PercentDecode`](/docs/api/encoding/percent#percent-decode) writes for it

<h2 id="percent-decode"><code>PercentDecode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func PercentDecode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var byte[..],
    set: PercentSet
) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

Reads percent-encoded text into `into`, turning each escape back into its byte.
Characters outside an escape are copied as they are, except that `+` becomes a space when `set` is `Form`; the
other sets give `+` no special meaning. Reports `InvalidEscape` at the first `%` that is not followed by two
hexadecimal digits, and `InsufficientCapacity` with the length needed when `into` is too short; both leave `into`
untouched, because the whole text is checked before anything is written.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Percent.rux#L166)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                     |
| ------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]`    | the percent-encoded text to decode                              |
| `into` | `var byte[..]` | the destination, at least `PercentDecodedLength(text)` bytes    |
| `set`  | `PercentSet`   | the set the text was encoded for, which decides how `+` is read |

**Returns**: the number of bytes written
